Macro.Name: Respond to HE-initiated refresh request

Action.Name: HE queries when needed by pinging to make sure the computer is on / EG is running.
Optional event payload is the timer interval for future heartbeats.
Restart heartbeat refresh timer with HE settings

Macro.Action:
EventGhost.PythonScript(u'# HE queries by pinging with the expected heartbeat interval as payload 
# if no payload is received for any reason, a 3 minute default is used.
try:
 # Try to convert the payload to a float
 seconds = float(eg.event.payload[0])
except (IndexError, ValueError, TypeError):
 # Fallback to 180 if the payload is missing, empty, or not a number
 seconds = 180.0

# Run the timer action using the verified seconds value
eg.PrintNotice(u"Ping received. Setting timer duration to %d seconds." % (seconds,))
eg.plugins.Timer.TimerAction(u'HE Refresh', 0, 0, seconds, u'refresh.he', False, True, 1, u'00:00:00')')
